title: Book of Evil
statementMd:
Paladin Manao caught the trail of the ancient Book of Evil in a swampy area. This area contains $*n*$ settlements numbered from 1 to $*n*$. Moving through the swamp is very difficult, so people tramped exactly $*n* - 1$ paths. Each of these paths connects some pair of settlements and is bidirectional. Moreover, it is possible to reach any settlement from any other one by traversing one or several paths.

The *distance* between two settlements is the minimum number of paths that have to be crossed to get from one settlement to the other one. Manao knows that the Book of Evil has got a damage range $*d*$. This means that if the Book of Evil is located in some settlement, its damage (for example, emergence of ghosts and werewolves) affects other settlements at distance $*d*$ or less from the settlement where the Book resides.

Manao has heard of $*m*$ settlements affected by the Book of Evil. Their numbers are $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*m*}$. Note that the Book may be affecting other settlements as well, but this has not been detected yet. Manao wants to determine which settlements may contain the Book. Help him with this difficult task.

## Input

The first line contains three space-separated integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*d*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n* ≤ 100000; 0 ≤ *d* ≤ *n* - 1$). The second line contains $*m*$ distinct space-separated integers $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$). Then $*n* - 1$ lines follow, each line describes a path made in the area. A path is described by a pair of space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ representing the ends of this path.

## Output

Print a single number — the number of settlements that may contain the Book of Evil. It is possible that Manao received some controversial information and there is no settlement that may contain the Book. In such case, print 0.

## Note

Sample 1. The damage range of the Book of Evil equals 3 and its effects have been noticed in settlements 1 and 2. Thus, it can be in settlements 3, 4 or 5.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/069017c8e4bebd842664cc76a5bdc5c9d39240a6.png)
statementZhMd:
圣骑士 Manao 在一片沼泽地区发现了古老的邪恶之书留下的踪迹。这个地区包含 $*n*$ 个编号为 1 到 $*n*$ 的聚居地。由于穿越沼泽非常困难，人们恰好修建了 $*n* - 1$ 条道路。每条道路连接某一对聚居地，并且可以双向通行。此外，从任意一个聚居地出发，都可以通过一条或多条道路到达其他任意聚居地。

两个聚居地之间的*距离*是从一个聚居地到达另一个聚居地所必须经过的最少道路数。Manao 知道邪恶之书的影响范围为 $*d*$。这意味着，如果邪恶之书位于某个聚居地，那么它造成的影响（例如出现鬼魂和狼人）会波及与该聚居地距离不超过 $*d*$ 的其他聚居地。

Manao 听说有 $*m*$ 个聚居地受到了邪恶之书的影响，它们的编号为 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*m*}$。注意，邪恶之书可能还影响了其他聚居地，只是目前尚未被发现。Manao 想确定哪些聚居地可能藏有邪恶之书。请帮助他完成这项艰巨的任务。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*d*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n* ≤ 100000; 0 ≤ *d* ≤ *n* - 1$）。第二行包含 $*m*$ 个互不相同的、用空格分隔的整数 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）。接下来 $*n* - 1$ 行，每行描述该地区中的一条道路。每条道路由两个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i}$ 和 $*b*_{*i}$ 表示，分别代表这条道路的两个端点。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——可能藏有邪恶之书的聚居地数量。Manao 得到的信息可能存在矛盾，因此可能不存在任何一个聚居地可以藏有邪恶之书。在这种情况下，输出 0。

## 说明

样例 1：邪恶之书的影响范围等于 3，并且在聚居地 1 和 2 发现了它的影响。因此，它可能位于聚居地 3、4 或 5。
